label: autophagy
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell degrades intracellular material, including its own constituents or intracellular non-self cargo, by delivering that material to lysosomal or vacuolar compartments.
observations: Corrected nuclear-cargo scope (#1754); supersedes v514-v518 parent wording.

label: nucleophagy
definition: An autophagy phenotype in which a microbial cell degrades parts of its nucleus or an entire nucleus by delivering nuclear material to lysosomal or vacuolar compartments.
observations: Nuclear portions or whole nuclei; route and selectivity scope remains source-attributed.
